_note: Captions are deliberately conservative — where the vehicle could not be identified with certainty from the source photo, a neutral description is used rather than a guess. Ash should replace these with the real vehicle and package for each job; that is also what makes the alt text worth something for SEO.
_imageNote: The ba/* files are 1536x2048 originals — roughly four times the resolution of the older gallery/* files, which are low-resolution web copies. The build never upscales, so older shots are capped at their source size. The gallery/w*.jpg files added September 2026 are 1066x1600 — number plates were blurred before import, so they need no entry in redactions.json.
